continuity.scope: Potential single-choice rerank per actor, all baseline traits/history/trajectories and other actors fixed. Ordinary strategic choices only; not an enabled-trait rollout. Eligible history: completed damage/attack plan, own life, victim ID+life, 6s window, damage D>0 and anchor radius3. Zero-C control must match actual choice.

cost.definition: Full getBotInputs + stepMatch over 3600 ticks; no audit/HUD/candidate observers
cost.summary: Median of whole 8-seed round ms/tick; per-seed median of three samples

method.definition: Full getBotInputs + stepMatch over 3600 ticks; no audit/HUD/candidate observers
method.summary: Median of whole 8-seed round ms/tick; per-seed median of three samples
